name: io.github.Kungie/gut
title: gut
description: Judgment calls on small, cheap models: is this spam, which team, how urgent. YES, NO or UNSURE.

environmentVariables.name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Key for TypeSafe's Jev, the model asked by default when it is set

environmentVariables.name: GUT_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Another model: openrouter, ollaya, clm, ollama, openai, zeroshot or transformers

environmentVariables.name: GUT_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: The model to ask; required for ollaya, ollama and openai

environmentVariables.name: GUT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The server's URL, for ollaya, ollama and openai

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Key for Jev through OpenRouter, with GUT_BACKEND=openrouter
